peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 4.4% below its local comparables; 33 of 85 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (4.5): 0.8 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 12 of 266 similar developments with a figure. Context, not scored: resales in 41.7% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 3-bedroom: median $2,606,500 ($1,631 psf, 1,227–1,657 sq ft; 6 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,707 psf (range $1,507–1,775); 4.4% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $121,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Petir LRT about 460 m, Pending LRT about 470 m; closer than 300 of 462 similar developments (the same as 9). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 3 within 1 km and 8 within 2 km; nearest Bukit Panjang Primary School about 150 m; more than 340 of 462 similar developments (the same as 68). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 3 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 660 m), more than 206 of 462 similar developments (the same as 81); nearest hawker centre Bukit Panjang Hawker Centre about 660 m; nearest park Rail Corridor about 610 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 5 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (The Myst, 46 new sales, about 430 m; The Botany at Dairy Farm, 2 new sales, about 950 m; Narra Residences, 214 new sales, about 970 m; The Arden, 3 new sales, about 1,300 m; Hillhaven, 13 new sales, about 1,380 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 42 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 278 new sales and 473 resales (751 purchases); new sales were 37% of these purchases. Subsales (27) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Dairy Farm Walk GLS site (Jan 2026) (government land sale site, awarded), about 800 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 473 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 74 of 462 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 473 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 519 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−8.9%). Planning-area private resales −27.4%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
